title: Crispy Moroccan Flatbread Topping with Jagged Rye
description: A flavorful and crunchy flatbread topping made with crispy jagged rye, moroccan spices, and other delicious ingredients.
instructions: 2. In a bowl, mix together crispy jagged rye, moroccan spice blend, and salt.
3. Brush flatbread with olive oil on both sides.
4. Sprinkle the rye mixture evenly over the flatbread.
5. Bake in the oven for 10-12 minutes or until crispy and golden brown.
6. Remove from oven and sprinkle with fresh parsley.
